name: Patch Serein
seed: Keeps the crew’s devices and relays working. Claims he only maintains equipment; must confront the harm he enables.
design: Male gecko, sage skin with ochre speckles, rust utility vest, amber magnifier and repaired bag.
history: Reedbank electronics apprentice who followed better pay into gray-market maintenance. Nix first hired him to repair a legal relay.
desire: To leave with enough money to run a legitimate workshop.
contradiction: Insists equipment has no morality while selecting jobs that enable harm.
relationships: Bot shows a life he thinks he missed; Tessera keeps incriminating receipts; Nix alternates warmth and pressure.
arc: Stops maintaining a dangerous relay, preserves evidence and accepts the consequences of his prior work.
story_engine: A broken device is also the only evidence against him; a child admires him for the wrong accomplishment.
writer_truth: He has helped harmful operations knowingly. Defection requires repair and truthful testimony, not a new nickname.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
